segments.say: Loopback Transformer: towards a unified view of residual looped transformers.
segments.display: Loopback Transformer: towards a unified view of residual looped Transformers.

segments.say: Looped transformers apply the same blocks again and again. Sharing fixes the weights, but not how each update is reused.
segments.display: Looped Transformers apply the same blocks again and again. Sharing fixes the weights, but not how each update is reused.

segments.say: Addition gives every update weight one, so the total grows with depth. A joint softmax shares one unit of weight, so the input shrinks. Loopback keeps the input at one; decay sets the total, and attention allocates it.
segments.display: Addition gives every update weight one, so the total grows with depth. A joint softmax shares one unit of weight, so the input shrinks. Loopback keeps the input at one; decay sets the total, and attention allocates it.

segments.say: The recipe: store updates, not outputs; keep the input on its own path; let decay set the total, and attention allocate it.
segments.display: The recipe: store updates, not outputs; keep the input on its own path; let decay set the total, and attention allocate it.

segments.say: From one hundred ninety-one million to three billion parameters, Loopback reaches lower validation loss than the standard transformer, with forty to seventy-five percent of its parameters.
segments.display: From 191M to 3B parameters, Loopback reaches lower validation loss than the standard Transformer, with 40–75% of its parameters.

segments.say: At three hundred seventy-four million, it is the best of nine models in both loss and thirteen-task mean.
segments.display: At 374M, it is the best of nine models in both loss and thirteen-task mean.

segments.say: The read costs a fraction of a percent in flops, the same K V cache, and smaller weights.
segments.display: The read costs a fraction of a percent in FLOPs, the same KV cache, and smaller weights.

segments.say: Store updates. Keep the input on its own path. Decay sets the total; attention allocates it.
segments.display: Store updates. Keep the input on its own path. Decay sets the total; attention allocates it.
